about: Keeper's files contract vectors (syncular/README.md, The drive; story 116.1). Hand-written, never generated; every implementation reproduces each entry (keeper's in keeper-files-api and keeper-paths tests). Format: fixtures are manifests (bulk rows expand to count live text/markdown files with ids prefix + zero-padded n); a case's steps run in order on its fixture, each through the reference evaluator, and its expect is a subset of the result (or a refusal code with nothing changed). Review sections (proposals, reviews, outcomes; story 116.6; runner keeper-files-api tests/review_vectors.rs): a case's optional roles map sets domain roles (actor -> owner|editor|reviewer|reader) before its steps. A step is either {roles: {actor: role|null}} (set a role; null removes it) or {caller, descriptor, params, server?, expect}. Before a step runs, any string in params of the form $digest:<proposal_id>/<revision> becomes that stored revision's digest and $delta:<event_id> that event's delta_digest (so most digests come from the implementation; a literal digest pins the formula). server: event_id, recorded_at_ms (the clock for expiry, also for files.proposals), client_id, review_id (first review of files.acknowledge or files.reverse), review_ids (further acknowledgement reviews, in order), event_ids (further approvals of a files.decide list, in order). expect, per descriptor: files.propose: outcome proposed (detail: subset of {proposal_id, proposal_revision, proposal_digest}) or rejected with code (and detail subset); files.decide: receipt (subset of the whole receipt, per-decision detail in list order) or outcome rejected with code for a whole-list refusal; files.proposal, files.proposals, files.unreviewed: read (subset of the result) and/or read_ids (the exact ordered row ids, or event ids for files.unreviewed), or outcome rejected with code; other descriptors: outcome accepted (event, op_count, ops subsets) or rejected with code. Every step may also check the state after it: proposal_rows (row id -> subset, null = absent), inbox (id -> subset), inbox_absent (ids), reviews (id -> subset), events (event id -> subset), entries (id -> subset, null = absent), head (subset). A rejected step must leave entries, head, proposals, inbox and reviews unchanged.
